target_customer: Banks, fintechs and non-bank lenders that need consumer lending compliance
problem: Compliance teams manually review calls, complaints and marketing for violations and draft regulatory reports; Shiboleth automates monitoring and reporting.
business_model: B2B SaaS for regulated lenders and bank partners

founders.name: Esty Scheiner
education: Left NYU computer science program; self taught CISSP and OSCP
founders.background_notes: Security engineer at Invoca who built an LLM compliance tool.

founders.name: Bivu Dhungana
founders.background_notes: About a decade as an ML engineer; led IVR fraud detection at Pindrop.

technical_complexity.rationale: LLM based review of call transcripts against multiple regulations with security demands for banks.

defensibility.rationale: Compliance workflows and bank trust create stickiness, though contact center AI vendors can extend into compliance.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Ncontracts launched AI complaint tools in 2025 and several call QA vendors offer compliance monitoring.

market_need_then: Regulators scrutinise bank fintech partnerships and lenders; Axios and Crowd Fund Insider covered the company's February 2025 emergence from stealth as a bank fintech compliance play.

brand_strength.rationale: The name appears to be a misspelling of the word shibboleth, which is also the well known identity software; search results were dominated by that word, which hurts findability.

outcome_analysis: Shiboleth is an active YC W24 company with a founding team from security and bank fraud detection. It emerged from stealth in February 2025 with a reported $1.5M seed, and no later round, exit or distress was found. Findability suffers from its name, and competition from call QA vendors is growing.
notes: $1.5M seed is reported by Crowd Fund Insider and the Axios Pro URL and headline (both pages could not be fully opened; figures taken from search summaries) and is consistent. CB Insights lists $2M over 3 rounds and Pioneer Fund; TheCompanyCheck lists $500K in June 2024; these are unverified. Name origin is not stated. No dated competitors near the batch were found; those listed in search were 2025 or later.
